title: Senior Software Engineer - SDET
description:
### **Why join Stryker?**


Looking for a place that values your unique talents? Discover Stryker's award\-winning culture.  

We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.### **Job description**


We are excited to be named one of the World’s Best Workplaces by Fortune Magazine!
  

We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific. **Senior Software Engineer – Software Test Engineering (Individual Contributor)**

**Position Summary**


We are seeking a **Senior Software Engineer \- Software Test Engineering** with **3\-6 years of experience** to drive software quality through functional testing, white box testing, code analysis, and defect troubleshooting. The ideal candidate combines strong testing expertise with programming skills in **Python and C\#** and can work independently while collaborating closely with development teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and author functional verification scenarios, test cases, and test reports.
* Execute functional, integration, regression, and white\-box testing activities.
* Develop and maintain test automation scripts and tools using Python and/or C\#.
* Write scripts to address real\-time testing, troubleshooting, and operational challenges.
* Analyze code differentials and assess testing impact for software changes.
* Troubleshoot defects at the code level and support root cause analysis.
* Collaborate closely with software developers to investigate issues and validate fixes.
* Ensure software quality through thorough verification and risk\-based testing.
* Drive continuous improvement in testing processes, automation, and quality practices.
* Participate in Agile development activities including sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related discipline.
* 2\-5 years of experience in Software Test Engineering
* Proven track record in:
	+ Functional Testing
	+ White\-Box Testing
	+ Test Automation
	+ Issue Troubleshooting
	+ Test Case Authoring
	+ Test Report Preparation
* Working knowledge and debugging skills in **Python and C\#**.
* Experience analyzing source code changes and determining testing impact.
* Ability to troubleshoot software defects at the code level.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with automated testing frameworks and CI/CD practices.
* Understanding of **VoIP concepts**, call flows, and communication systems.
* Experience with source control tools (Git, Azure DevOps, etc.).
* Knowledge of software quality metrics and risk\-based testing methodologies.


Location GGN/BLR


Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.

title: AI Automation Engineer (Agentic AI)
description:
**Company Description** **About Pramira**


Pramira is a California\-based engineering and construction company specializing in telecommunications, electrical, and infrastructure projects. We are hiring an AI Automation Engineer to join our team in India.

 **Job Description** **About the Role**


You will study how our teams work, find tasks that AI agents and automation can take over, and then build, deploy, and maintain those solutions. You will use free, open\-source, and existing Microsoft 365 tools wherever possible, running them on the cloud or on our own servers. This is a hands\-on role: you will own your solutions from idea to daily use.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Review workflows with our operations, project, field, finance, and HR teams and find where AI can save time
* Build AI agents that can plan, use tools, and complete multi\-step business tasks
* Build an AI assistant that answers staff questions from our company procedures and policies (RAG)
* Automate construction tasks such as RFI drafting, document data extraction, bid screening, compliance reminders, and weekly reports
* Connect agents to Microsoft 365 (SharePoint, Teams, Power Automate), Smartsheet, and other systems through APIs
* Deploy and run open\-source platforms such as n8n, LangGraph, CrewAI, and Ollama using Docker on Linux or cloud servers
* Monitor performance, fix issues, control costs, and keep sensitive data secure
* Document your work and train staff to use the tools

  

**Qualifications** **Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or equivalent experience
* 3\+ years in software development or automation, including 1\+ year building LLM applications or AI agents
* Strong Python skills and experience with REST APIs
* Hands\-on experience with at least one agent framework (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or n8n)
* Experience with RAG and vector databases (Chroma, Qdrant, pgvector, or similar)
* Experience deploying applications with Docker on Linux and on at least one cloud platform
* Experience with both commercial LLM APIs and open\-source models run locally
* Good spoken and written English, and the ability to explain technical work to non\-technical staff

**Nice to Have**

* Power Automate, SharePoint, Microsoft Graph, or Copilot Studio experience
* Smartsheet API experience
* Experience in construction, telecom, engineering, or field services
* OCR and data extraction from PDFs, drawings, and forms
* Experience working with US\-based teams

**What We Offer**

* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Paid sick leave
* Direct work with company leadership on high\-impact projects
* Freedom to choose and build the tools that shape how the company runs

**Application Questions**

* Describe one AI agent or automation you built that people use regularly. What did it do?
* Which agent frameworks have you used in production?
* Have you run open\-source language models on your own server? Which ones?
* Can you work (X) hours of daily overlap with US Pacific time?
* What is your current and expected annual CTC, and your notice period?

  

**Additional Information**  

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: SDET 2
description:
**About AiDASH**  

  

AiDASH is leading the PreventionFirst™movement for electric utilities and transforming grid resilience through its pioneering platform that unifies vegetation, asset, storm, and wildfire intelligence. Powered by SatelliteFirst™ Inspection \& Monitoring, AiDASH delivers comprehensive visibility across the entire grid at the right frequency and budget, using the right data modality. More than 200 customers trust AiDASH to keep the lights on, spend where it counts, and defend every decision, Securing Tomorrow across every mile of the grid. Learn more at www.aidash.com.



The PreventionFirst movement is growing, and so is the recognition behind it. In 2026, Forbes named AiDASH one of America's Best Startup Employers for the 4th consecutive year, and TIME included AiDASH among America's Top GreenTech Companies for the 3rd year in a row. Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ ranked AiDASH No. 12 in the San Francisco Bay Area, and No. 59 overall in their selection of the top 500 for 2024\.



Join us in Securing Tomorrow Together!

#### **The Role**



As an SDET 2 at AiDASH, you will own the quality of the AI\-powered applications behind our offerings. You will understand application requirements and architecture, then build test strategies that cover both functional behaviour and performance. Your work will include API automation using Java and RestAssured, data validation, performance testing with tools like JMeter, and monitoring application health after release. You will also validate the accuracy of AI/ML\-driven outputs and use AI tools to speed up how you test. Success means shipping reliable, high\-performing applications that help our teams deliver faster.

  

**How you'll make an impact:**


* Creating comprehensive test strategies that validate both functional and performance aspects of the system under test
* Analysing functional and non\-functional requirements from a coverage and impact perspective, and designing effective and efficient test cases
* Writing robust and maintainable API test automation using Java and the RestAssured framework, along with other tools and scripts that make testing more efficient
* Contributing to enhancing the automation framework based on the needs of the project/requirements
* Performing data validation testing across APIs, databases like Postgres and MongoDB, and the outputs of data processing solutions
* Conducting performance testing and benchmarking of applications using tools like JMeter
* Preparing test data for QA validations by coordinating with multiple teams and ramping up quickly across different contexts
* Creating the automation pipeline using Jenkins or other build tools to trigger the automation, and using reporting tools like ExtentReports or Allure for clear and detailed test reports
* Monitoring post\-production application health and alerts, including working with Kubernetes clusters and AWS services to check service health and logs
* Documenting and managing defects throughout their lifecycle, conducting root cause analysis, and coordinating with Test and Development team members to resolve issues
* Contributing to the quality of our upcoming in\-house orchestration platform, a one\-stop solution for invoking and reporting on the various data processing solutions.

  

  

**What we're looking for:**


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent from a reputed university with good academic results is preferred
* Hands\-on experience testing backend applications, with strong skills in API testing and data validation testing
* Hands\-on experience in API automation using Java and RestAssured, and/or Python scripting, with a good understanding of test frameworks
* Experience in performance testing using tools like JMeter
* Hands\-on experience with databases like Postgres and MongoDB, and writing queries for data validation
* Knowledge of AWS services and experience working with Kubernetes clusters for checking service health and logs
* Understanding of queues and caching
* Strong attention to detail and curiosity to understand the internal workings of software
* Good analytical skills and decision making ability, with the ability to work in a team as well as an individual
* Ability to work under pressure and maintain deadlines
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Good to have: gRPC basics, Airflow DAGs, web application testing and automation using Selenium/Playwright, knowledge of testing and validating ML/AI based applications, and use of AI tools and editors for increased velocity of work


We are proud to be an equal\-opportunity employer. We are committed to embracing diversity and inclusion in our hiring practices, and we promote a work environment where everyone, from any race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin, can do their best work.


We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible interview experience for all candidates. Please let us know if you require any accommodation during the interview process, and we will make every effort to meet your needs.  

  

Read our Privacy Policy here: https://www.aidash.com/policy/privacy\-policy/

title: Test Automation Engineer
description:
**Project Role :** Test Automation Engineer  

**Project Role Description :** Use quality processes, automation tools, and methodologies to transform testing products and solutions. Run end\-to\-end quality engineering function with a focus on automation to improve control, accuracy and integrity.
  

**Must have skills :** Veeva CRM testing  

**Good to have skills :** Salesforce CRM Analytics, Veeva CRM  

Minimum **3** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary:  

As a Veeva CRM Senior Tester, a typical day involves designing and executing testing for implementations, integrations, and releases in a regulated life sciences environment. The role owns test preparation, execution, defect investigation, validation evidence, and delivery of high\-quality results. This position focuses on ensuring quality, compliance, traceability, and release readiness across Veeva CRM programs while collaborating with cross\-functional teams, supporting testing best practices, and contributing to continuous improvement in testing processes and automation.  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities:  

* Analyze requirements and prepare test scenarios, cases, data, and traceability.
* Execute functional, integration, regression, end\-to\-end, mobile, data migration, and UAT testing.
* Validate Veeva CRM commercial processes, Salesforce configurations, integrations, and offline scenarios.
* Record clear evidence, identify and report defects, perform retesting, and support root\-cause analysis.
* Maintain GxP, CSV, data integrity, privacy, security, and audit\-ready documentation.
* Coordinate with business, development, validation, and support teams to resolve issues.
* Report progress, risks, blockers, and test results to the Test Lead.
* Support junior testers, peer reviews, automation, regression optimization, and reusable assets.
* Own test execution activities with a strong focus on accuracy, risk awareness, and quality outcomes.
* Support defect analysis, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ensure on\-time completion of assigned testing, validation evidence, timely identification and communication of issues, and effective retesting activities.
* Deliver strong coverage, traceability, defect quality, reduced escaped defects, and improved regression efficiency.

  

Professional \& Technical Skills:  

* Must Have Skills: Hands\-on Veeva CRM testing experience in a life sciences environment.
* Secondary skills include Veeva CRM, Salesforce, ISTQB, or Agile certification.
* Experience testing Veeva CRM in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical\-device, or life sciences environments.
* Good knowledge of accounts, calls, consent, Approved Email, CLM, events, samples, territories, and mobile/offline functionality.
* Experience in test analysis, design, execution, defect management, traceability, data validation, integration testing, and UAT support.
* Ability to write clear test cases, query data, validate interfaces, analyze defects, and produce audit\-ready evidence.
* Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, ALM/Quality Center, Zephyr, or equivalent tools.
* Exposure to Selenium, Cucumber, Tosca, or similar automation tools.
* Understanding of Agile delivery, GxP, CSV, ALCOA\+, data integrity, and validation controls.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, documentation, collaboration, and communication skills.
* Strong learning agility, stakeholder collaboration, and effective communication skills.
* Experience with Veeva Commercial Cloud, CLM, Approved Email, Align, MyInsights, or iOS offline testing is preferred.
* Exposure to API, database, automation, performance, accessibility, and security testing is preferred.

  

Additional Information:  

* The candidate should have 4–6 years of software testing or quality engineering experience, including at least 2 years of hands\-on Veeva CRM testing.
* Bachelor s degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent experience.
* This is based at our Accenture Office

  

15 years full time education
